description: Collect public Facebook photos from a page, profile, album, photo permalink, tagged collection, or albums list.

includeAlbums.description: For page and profile URLs, also walk every album listed on the page's Albums tab and collect its photos. A photos_albums URL implies this automatically.
includeAlbums.title: Also collect albums

includeDetails.description: Open each photo to add its caption, timestamp, reactions, comments, shares, tagged people, owner, album, and post link. Turn off for a fast grid-only export; album date bounds still read only the timestamp needed for filtering.
includeDetails.title: Include photo details

newerThan.description: Only include photos posted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Applied by Facebook for page and tagged tabs. For albums the actor reads each photo timestamp (even with includeDetails off) and applies the bound; rows stay grid-only.
newerThan.title: Only photos newer than

olderThan.description: Only include photos posted on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Applied by Facebook for page and tagged tabs. For albums the actor reads each photo timestamp (even with includeDetails off) and applies the bound; rows stay grid-only.
olderThan.title: Only photos older than

photoTab.description: For page and profile URLs: photos uploaded by the page, or photos where the page is tagged by others. Ignored for album and photo URLs.
enumTitles: Photos the page is tagged in
photoTab.title: Photo tab

resultsLimit.description: Global cap across all Start URLs. The actor keeps paginating until this many photos are collected or the source runs out.
resultsLimit.title: Maximum number of photos

startUrls.description: Facebook page, profile, photos tab, tagged tab, albums tab, album, or single-photo URL. Bare handles such as nasa are accepted too.

url.description: Facebook page, profile, photo album, photos tab, tagged tab, or photo permalink.
url.title: URL of a web page

startUrls.title: Facebook URLs

storeImages.description: Copy each full-size image and thumbnail to Apify storage and return non-expiring URLs. The signed Facebook originals and their expiry are kept in the record.
storeImages.title: Store images permanently

title: Facebook Photos Scraper Input
